q_gram_c2_01_001.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'topicalización'?
wrong: it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
anaphora (reference back to a previously mentioned element)
q_gram_c2_01_001.explanation: 'topicalización' signifie 'topicalization (fronting an element for emphasis)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La verdad, esa la sabemos todos.
q_gram_c2_01_001.hint: The truth — that, we all know.

q_gram_c2_01_002.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'nominalización'?
q_gram_c2_01_002.explanation: 'nominalización' signifie 'nominalization (turning verbs/adjectives into nouns)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La implementación del proyecto requiere financiación.
q_gram_c2_01_002.hint: The implementation of the project requires funding.

q_gram_c2_01_003.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'cacofonía'?
wrong: textual cohesion (linguistic links within a text)
q_gram_c2_01_003.explanation: 'cacofonía' signifie 'cacophony (unpleasant repetition of sounds)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Hay que evitar la cacofonía en la prosa cuidada.
q_gram_c2_01_003.hint: One must avoid cacophony in polished prose.

q_gram_c2_01_004.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'matiz'?
q_gram_c2_01_004.explanation: 'matiz' signifie 'nuance / shade of meaning' comme montré dans l'exemple: Cada palabra tiene un matiz diferente.
q_gram_c2_01_004.hint: Each word has a different nuance.

q_gram_c2_02_005.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'fuere'?
q_gram_c2_02_005.correct: were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)
wrong: use of 'le' as direct object pronoun
q_gram_c2_02_005.explanation: 'fuere' signifie 'were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Donde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
q_gram_c2_02_005.hint: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

q_gram_c2_02_006.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'vuestra merced'?
wrong: to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_02_006.explanation: 'vuestra merced' signifie 'your grace (archaic, origin of 'usted')' comme montré dans l'exemple: Vuestra merced es muy generoso.

q_gram_c2_02_007.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'maguer'?
q_gram_c2_02_007.explanation: 'maguer' signifie 'although (archaic, medieval)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Maguer que era pobre, era honrado.
q_gram_c2_02_007.hint: Although he was poor, he was honorable.

q_gram_c2_02_008.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'dativo ético'?
q_gram_c2_02_008.explanation: 'dativo ético' signifie 'ethical dative (expressive, non-argument pronoun)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El niño no me come nada.
q_gram_c2_02_008.hint: The child won't eat anything (and it worries me).

q_gram_c2_03_009.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'voseo'?
wrong: were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)
q_gram_c2_03_009.explanation: 'voseo' signifie 'use of 'vos' instead of 'tú'' comme montré dans l'exemple: En Argentina, el voseo es la norma: vos sabés.
q_gram_c2_03_009.hint: In Argentina, voseo is the norm: you know.

q_gram_c2_03_010.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'leísmo'?
q_gram_c2_03_010.correct: use of 'le' as direct object pronoun
q_gram_c2_03_010.explanation: 'leísmo' signifie 'use of 'le' as direct object pronoun' comme montré dans l'exemple: Le vi ayer en el parque (leísmo aceptado).
q_gram_c2_03_010.hint: I saw him yesterday in the park (accepted leísmo).

q_gram_c2_03_011.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'dequeísmo'?
q_gram_c2_03_011.explanation: 'dequeísmo' signifie 'incorrect insertion of 'de' before 'que'' comme montré dans l'exemple: Incorrecto: *Pienso de que es verdad. Correcto: Pienso que es verdad.
q_gram_c2_03_011.hint: Incorrect: *I think of that it's true. Correct: I think that it's true.

q_gram_c2_03_012.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'nomás'?
q_gram_c2_03_012.explanation: 'nomás' signifie 'just / only (Mexico, Central America)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Pásele nomás, no tenga pena.
q_gram_c2_03_012.hint: Just come in, don't be shy.

q_gram_c2_04_013.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'es que'?
q_gram_c2_04_013.correct: it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
wrong: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
polysemy (one word with multiple related meanings)
q_gram_c2_04_013.explanation: 'es que' signifie 'it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Es que no sabía que era hoy.
q_gram_c2_04_013.hint: It's just that I didn't know it was today.

q_gram_c2_04_014.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'venga'?
wrong: polysemy (one word with multiple related meanings)
to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_04_014.explanation: 'venga' signifie 'come on / go ahead (pragmatic particle)' comme montré dans l'exemple: ¡Venga, que llegamos tarde!
q_gram_c2_04_014.hint: Come on, we're going to be late!

q_gram_c2_04_015.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'no quisiera molestarle'?
q_gram_c2_04_015.correct: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
q_gram_c2_04_015.explanation: 'no quisiera molestarle' signifie 'I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)' comme montré dans l'exemple: No quisiera molestarle, pero necesito su firma.
q_gram_c2_04_015.hint: I wouldn't want to bother you, but I need your signature.

q_gram_c2_04_016.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'ya veremos'?
wrong: to play a role (correct academic form)
prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
q_gram_c2_04_016.explanation: 'ya veremos' signifie 'we'll see (often a polite refusal)' comme montré dans l'exemple: —¿Puedo ir a la fiesta? —Ya veremos.
q_gram_c2_04_016.hint: —Can I go to the party? —We'll see.

q_gram_c2_05_017.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'estilo indirecto libre'?
q_gram_c2_05_017.explanation: 'estilo indirecto libre' signifie 'free indirect style (narrative technique)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Miró al cielo. No, no podía seguir así.
q_gram_c2_05_017.hint: He looked at the sky. No, he couldn't go on like this. (character's thought in narrator's voice)

q_gram_c2_05_018.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'condicional de rumor'?
wrong: were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)
reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_05_018.explanation: 'condicional de rumor' signifie 'conditional of rumor (journalistic use)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El ministro dimitiría la próxima semana.
q_gram_c2_05_018.hint: The minister would reportedly resign next week.

q_gram_c2_05_019.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'nominalización'?
wrong: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_05_019.explanation: 'nominalización' signifie 'nominalization (noun form of a verb/adjective)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La detención del sospechoso se produjo al amanecer.
q_gram_c2_05_019.hint: The arrest of the suspect took place at dawn.

q_gram_c2_05_020.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'texto argumentativo'?
q_gram_c2_05_020.explanation: 'texto argumentativo' signifie 'argumentative text' comme montré dans l'exemple: Un buen texto argumentativo presenta tesis, argumentos y contraargumentos.
q_gram_c2_05_020.hint: A good argumentative text presents a thesis, arguments, and counterarguments.

q_gram_c2_06_021.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'punto y coma'?
q_gram_c2_06_021.explanation: 'punto y coma' signifie 'semicolon' comme montré dans l'exemple: El plan era bueno; sin embargo, no funcionó.
q_gram_c2_06_021.hint: The plan was good; however, it didn't work.

q_gram_c2_06_022.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'comillas angulares'?
q_gram_c2_06_022.explanation: 'comillas angulares' signifie 'angle quotation marks (« »)' comme montré dans l'exemple: «La vida es sueño», escribió Calderón.

q_gram_c2_06_023.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'raya'?
wrong: to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_06_023.explanation: 'raya' signifie 'em dash (— used in dialogue)' comme montré dans l'exemple: —¿Qué quieres? —preguntó ella.

q_gram_c2_06_024.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'tilde diacrítica'?
q_gram_c2_06_024.explanation: 'tilde diacrítica' signifie 'diacritical accent mark (distinguishes homonyms)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Él quiere que tú le des más té.
q_gram_c2_06_024.hint: He wants you to give him more tea.

q_gram_c2_07_025.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'registro lingüístico'?
q_gram_c2_07_025.explanation: 'registro lingüístico' signifie 'linguistic register (level of formality)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El registro debe adecuarse al contexto comunicativo.
q_gram_c2_07_025.hint: The register must be adapted to the communicative context.

q_gram_c2_07_026.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'en plan'?
wrong: verbal regime (required preposition after a verb)
q_gram_c2_07_026.explanation: 'en plan' signifie 'like / sort of (colloquial filler, Spain)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Fue en plan broma, no te lo tomes a mal.
q_gram_c2_07_026.hint: It was like a joke, don't take it the wrong way.

q_gram_c2_07_027.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'coadyuvar'?
wrong: prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
q_gram_c2_07_027.explanation: 'coadyuvar' signifie 'to contribute to / assist (formal/legal)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Estas medidas coadyuvarán a la mejora del sistema.
q_gram_c2_07_027.hint: These measures will contribute to the improvement of the system.

q_gram_c2_07_028.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'por la presente'?
wrong: it should be noted (formal academic hedging)
q_gram_c2_07_028.explanation: 'por la presente' signifie 'hereby (formal/legal formula)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Por la presente se comunica la resolución del contrato.
q_gram_c2_07_028.hint: Hereby, the termination of the contract is communicated.

q_gram_c2_08_029.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'hipérbaton'?
wrong: prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
q_gram_c2_08_029.explanation: 'hipérbaton' signifie 'hyperbaton (deliberate disruption of word order)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Del salón en el ángulo oscuro... (Bécquer)
q_gram_c2_08_029.hint: In the dark corner of the room... (normal order inverted)

q_gram_c2_08_030.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'estilo indirecto libre'?
wrong: verbal regime (required preposition after a verb)
q_gram_c2_08_030.explanation: 'estilo indirecto libre' signifie 'free indirect style' comme montré dans l'exemple: Miró el reloj. Ya era tarde. Mañana lo haría mejor.
q_gram_c2_08_030.hint: He looked at the clock. It was already late. Tomorrow he would do better. (character's thought in narrator's voice)

q_gram_c2_08_031.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'asíndeton'?
wrong: anaphora (reference back to a previously mentioned element)
prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_08_031.explanation: 'asíndeton' signifie 'asyndeton (omission of conjunctions)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Llegué, vi, vencí.
q_gram_c2_08_031.hint: I came, I saw, I conquered.

q_gram_c2_08_032.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'polisíndeton'?
wrong: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
q_gram_c2_08_032.explanation: 'polisíndeton' signifie 'polysyndeton (repetition of conjunctions)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Y ríe y llora y canta y se lamenta.
q_gram_c2_08_032.hint: And he laughs and cries and sings and laments.

q_gram_c2_09_033.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'régimen verbal'?
q_gram_c2_09_033.correct: verbal regime (required preposition after a verb)
q_gram_c2_09_033.explanation: 'régimen verbal' signifie 'verbal regime (required preposition after a verb)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El verbo 'insistir' rige la preposición 'en': insistir en.
q_gram_c2_09_033.hint: The verb 'insistir' governs the preposition 'en': to insist on.

q_gram_c2_09_034.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'dequeísmo'?
wrong: it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
q_gram_c2_09_034.explanation: 'dequeísmo' signifie 'incorrect insertion of 'de' before 'que'' comme montré dans l'exemple: Incorrecto: *Creo de que es así. Correcto: Creo que es así.
q_gram_c2_09_034.hint: Incorrect: *I believe of that it's so. Correct: I believe that it's so.

q_gram_c2_09_035.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'concordancia'?
q_gram_c2_09_035.explanation: 'concordancia' signifie 'grammatical agreement (gender, number)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El agua está fría, no *frío (concordancia de género).
q_gram_c2_09_035.hint: The water is cold, not *cold-masc. (gender agreement).

q_gram_c2_09_036.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'gerundio'?
wrong: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
anaphora (reference back to a previously mentioned element)
q_gram_c2_09_036.explanation: 'gerundio' signifie 'gerund (-ando, -iendo form)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Correcto: Entró cantando. Incorrecto: *Una ley regulando el comercio.
q_gram_c2_09_036.hint: Correct: He entered singing. Incorrect: *A law regulating commerce.

q_gram_c2_10_037.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'cohesión textual'?
q_gram_c2_10_037.correct: textual cohesion (linguistic links within a text)
wrong: to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_10_037.explanation: 'cohesión textual' signifie 'textual cohesion (linguistic links within a text)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La cohesión textual se logra mediante conectores, pronombres y repetición léxica.
q_gram_c2_10_037.hint: Textual cohesion is achieved through connectors, pronouns, and lexical repetition.

q_gram_c2_10_038.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'anáfora (discursiva)'?
q_gram_c2_10_038.correct: anaphora (reference back to a previously mentioned element)
wrong: were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)
q_gram_c2_10_038.explanation: 'anáfora (discursiva)' signifie 'anaphora (reference back to a previously mentioned element)' comme montré dans l'exemple: María llegó. Ella traía un regalo.
q_gram_c2_10_038.hint: María arrived. She was bringing a gift. ('Ella' refers back to 'María')

q_gram_c2_10_039.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'progresión temática'?
q_gram_c2_10_039.explanation: 'progresión temática' signifie 'thematic progression (information flow in text)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La empresa abrió una tienda. Esta tienda resultó muy exitosa.
q_gram_c2_10_039.hint: The company opened a store. This store turned out to be very successful.

q_gram_c2_10_040.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'oración escindida'?
q_gram_c2_10_040.explanation: 'oración escindida' signifie 'cleft sentence (focus structure)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Fue María quien encontró la solución.
q_gram_c2_10_040.hint: It was María who found the solution.

q_gram_c2_11_041.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'transposición'?
wrong: to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_11_041.explanation: 'transposición' signifie 'transposition (changing grammatical category in translation)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Antes de salir = Before leaving (infinitive ↔ gerund).
q_gram_c2_11_041.hint: Before leaving = Antes de salir (gerund ↔ infinitive in translation).

q_gram_c2_11_042.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'modulación'?
wrong: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
q_gram_c2_11_042.explanation: 'modulación' signifie 'modulation (changing perspective in translation)' comme montré dans l'exemple: No es difícil = It's quite easy (negative → positive).
q_gram_c2_11_042.hint: It's not difficult = Es bastante fácil (negative → positive shift).

q_gram_c2_11_043.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'falso amigo'?
wrong: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_11_043.explanation: 'falso amigo' signifie 'false friend (deceptive cognate)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Actualmente significa 'currently', no 'actually'.

q_gram_c2_11_044.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'pasiva refleja'?
q_gram_c2_11_044.correct: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
wrong: it should be noted (formal academic hedging)
q_gram_c2_11_044.explanation: 'pasiva refleja' signifie 'reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Se venden pisos = Apartments for sale (not *Son vendidos pisos).
q_gram_c2_11_044.hint: Apartments are sold = Se venden pisos (reflexive passive preferred).

q_gram_c2_12_045.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'quedarse de piedra'?
q_gram_c2_12_045.explanation: 'quedarse de piedra' signifie 'to be stunned / dumbfounded' comme montré dans l'exemple: Cuando me lo dijo, me quedé de piedra.
q_gram_c2_12_045.hint: When he told me, I was dumbfounded.

q_gram_c2_12_046.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'no sea que'?
wrong: prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
textual cohesion (linguistic links within a text)
q_gram_c2_12_046.explanation: 'no sea que' signifie 'lest / in case (+ subjunctive)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Lleva paraguas, no sea que llueva.
q_gram_c2_12_046.hint: Take an umbrella, in case it rains.

q_gram_c2_12_047.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'por lo visto'?
wrong: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_12_047.explanation: 'por lo visto' signifie 'apparently / so it seems' comme montré dans l'exemple: Por lo visto, la reunión se ha cancelado.
q_gram_c2_12_047.hint: Apparently, the meeting has been cancelled.

q_gram_c2_12_048.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'cuanto más... más'?
wrong: were to be (future subjunctive of ser/ir)
q_gram_c2_12_048.explanation: 'cuanto más... más' signifie 'the more... the more' comme montré dans l'exemple: Cuanto más practicas, más mejoras.
q_gram_c2_12_048.hint: The more you practice, the more you improve.

q_gram_c2_13_049.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'anfibología'?
q_gram_c2_13_049.explanation: 'anfibología' signifie 'amphibology (unintentional grammatical ambiguity)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La frase 'Recomendó a su hijo a su amigo' es una anfibología.
q_gram_c2_13_049.hint: The sentence 'He recommended his son to his friend' is an amphibology.

q_gram_c2_13_050.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'polisemia'?
q_gram_c2_13_050.correct: polysemy (one word with multiple related meanings)
wrong: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_13_050.explanation: 'polisemia' signifie 'polysemy (one word with multiple related meanings)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La palabra 'banco' tiene polisemia: asiento, entidad financiera, grupo de peces.
q_gram_c2_13_050.hint: The word 'banco' is polysemous: bench, bank, school of fish.

q_gram_c2_13_051.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'calambur'?
wrong: I wouldn't want to bother you (hedging)
q_gram_c2_13_051.explanation: 'calambur' signifie 'pun / wordplay based on sound' comme montré dans l'exemple: Oro parece, plata no es (plátano).
q_gram_c2_13_051.hint: It looks like gold, it's not silver (plantain — a sound-based pun).

q_gram_c2_13_052.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'doble sentido'?
q_gram_c2_13_052.explanation: 'doble sentido' signifie 'double meaning / double entendre' comme montré dans l'exemple: Muchos chistes en español se basan en el doble sentido.
q_gram_c2_13_052.hint: Many Spanish jokes are based on double meanings.

q_gram_c2_14_053.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'cabe señalar'?
q_gram_c2_14_053.correct: it should be noted (formal academic hedging)
q_gram_c2_14_053.explanation: 'cabe señalar' signifie 'it should be noted (formal academic hedging)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Cabe señalar que los datos presentan ciertas limitaciones.
q_gram_c2_14_053.hint: It should be noted that the data present certain limitations.

q_gram_c2_14_054.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'habida cuenta de'?
q_gram_c2_14_054.explanation: 'habida cuenta de' signifie 'taking into account / given that (formal)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Habida cuenta de los resultados, se modifica la hipótesis.
q_gram_c2_14_054.hint: Given the results, the hypothesis is modified.

q_gram_c2_14_055.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'de ahí que'?
wrong: it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
q_gram_c2_14_055.explanation: 'de ahí que' signifie 'hence / that is why (+ subjunctive)' comme montré dans l'exemple: No se replicó el estudio; de ahí que los resultados sean provisionales.
q_gram_c2_14_055.hint: The study was not replicated; hence the results are provisional.

q_gram_c2_14_056.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'desempeñar un papel'?
q_gram_c2_14_056.correct: to play a role (correct academic form)
q_gram_c2_14_056.explanation: 'desempeñar un papel' signifie 'to play a role (correct academic form)' comme montré dans l'exemple: La motivación desempeña un papel crucial en el aprendizaje.
q_gram_c2_14_056.hint: Motivation plays a crucial role in learning.

q_gram_c2_15_057.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'modo verbal'?
wrong: verbal regime (required preposition after a verb)
it's just that / the thing is (excuse/explanation)
q_gram_c2_15_057.explanation: 'modo verbal' signifie 'verbal mood (indicative, subjunctive, imperative)' comme montré dans l'exemple: El español tiene tres modos verbales: indicativo, subjuntivo e imperativo.
q_gram_c2_15_057.hint: Spanish has three verbal moods: indicative, subjunctive, and imperative.

q_gram_c2_15_058.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'régimen preposicional'?
q_gram_c2_15_058.correct: prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)
wrong: reflexive passive (se + verb, preferred in Spanish)
q_gram_c2_15_058.explanation: 'régimen preposicional' signifie 'prepositional regime (required preposition after a verb)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Cada verbo tiene su régimen: insistir en, depender de, confiar en.
q_gram_c2_15_058.hint: Each verb has its regime: to insist on, to depend on, to trust in.

q_gram_c2_15_059.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'condicional contrafactual'?
q_gram_c2_15_059.explanation: 'condicional contrafactual' signifie 'counterfactual conditional (Type 3: si hubiera... habría...)' comme montré dans l'exemple: Si hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado.
q_gram_c2_15_059.hint: If I had studied more, I would have passed.

q_gram_c2_15_060.question: Quel est le sens correct du mot 'dominio lingüístico'?
wrong: textual cohesion (linguistic links within a text)
q_gram_c2_15_060.explanation: 'dominio lingüístico' signifie 'linguistic mastery / command of language' comme montré dans l'exemple: El dominio lingüístico implica intuición gramatical, no solo conocimiento de reglas.
q_gram_c2_15_060.hint: Linguistic mastery implies grammatical intuition, not just knowledge of rules.

q_gram_c2_01_061.question:
